competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Apply basic first aid (strand ng community mobilization): kasama ang komunidad, natutukoy ng BHW ang isyu batay sa iniulat na ebidensiya at pananaw ng apektado, nag-iimbita nang may pagtugon sa hadlang sa pakikilahok, nangangasiwa ng maikling pulong na may kusang pinagkasunduang tungkulin ng pangunahing grupo, at bumubuo ng action plan na may responsable, kumpirmadong resources, petsa, follow-up at panukat na sinusuri kasama ang residente.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Apply basic first aid (community mobilization strand): working with the community, the BHW frames an issue from reported evidence and affected residents' perspectives, invites people while addressing barriers to participation, facilitates a short meeting that agrees voluntary core-group roles, and builds an action plan with an owner, confirmed resources, dates, follow-up and a measure reviewed with residents.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: May tiyak na ulat, apektadong grupo, nawawalang pananaw at tanong; walang bansag o personal na detalye.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Includes a specific report, affected group, missing perspective and question without labels or personal details.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ginagawang katotohanan ang bansag na tamad o ipinipili ang solusyon nang walang pakikinig.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Treats the label lazy as fact or imposes a solution without listening.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naihihiwalay ang tatlong ulat sa hula ng lider at may tanong sa hindi pa naririnig nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Separates the three reports from the leader’s assumption and asks about missing voices without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Malinaw ang ulat pero kailangang paalalahanang idagdag ang hindi pa naririnig.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: States the report clearly but needs a prompt to include missing voices.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ginagawang katotohanan ang bansag na tamad o ipinipili ang solusyon nang walang pakikinig.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Treats the label lazy as fact or imposes a solution without listening.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: May plano para sa tatlong hadlang, malinaw na tagapag-imbita at kusang-loob na paraan ng pakikilahok.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Plans for all three barriers with clear inviters and voluntary participation options.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Chat lamang ang plano para sa lahat o ginagawang kondisyon sa serbisyo ang pagdalo.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses only chat for everyone or conditions service access on attendance.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Magkakaiba at angkop ang tatlong paraan; may follow-up at walang pamimilit o pangako ng gantimpala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Uses three appropriate options with follow-up and no coercion or promised rewards.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May angkop na paanyaya pero kailangang paalalahanang maglagay ng follow-up o alternatibong mungkahi.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Uses suitable invitations but needs a prompt to include follow-up or another way to contribute.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Chat lamang ang plano para sa lahat o ginagawang kondisyon sa serbisyo ang pagdalo.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Uses only chat for everyone or conditions service access on attendance.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nagbibigay ng pagkakataong mag-ambag, nagbubuod ng pagkakaiba at nagkukumpirma ng kusang tungkulin habang isinasaalang-alang ang umiiral na grupo.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Invites contributions, summarizes differences and confirms voluntary roles while considering the existing group.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Lider lamang ang pinakikinggan o itinuturing na pagsang-ayon ang katahimikan.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Listens only to the leader or treats silence as agreement.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Narinig ang ibang mungkahi at malinaw ang pumayag na kasapi, papel at susunod na usapan nang walang pamimilit.
levels.kaya_na_en: Hears another suggestion and confirms willing members, roles and the next discussion without coercion.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagbigay ng pagkakataong magsalita pero kailangang paalalahanang kumpirmahin ang pagtanggap sa tungkulin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Invites contributions but needs a prompt to confirm acceptance of a role.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Lider lamang ang pinakikinggan o itinuturing na pagsang-ayon ang katahimikan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Listens only to the leader or treats silence as agreement.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: May gawain, responsable, kumpirmasyon ng resources, petsa, panukat at magalang na follow-up kasama ang komunidad.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Includes an action, owner, resource confirmation, date, measure and respectful community follow-up.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Hindi kumpirmadong resources ang ipinapangako o ipinapahiya ang hindi nakatapos.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Promises unconfirmed resources or shames someone who did not finish.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kumpleto ang plano; sinusuri ang natanggap na balita, hindi pagdalo lamang; may pag-aangkop sa hadlang nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Completes the plan, measures receipt of updates beyond attendance and adapts to barriers without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May tao at petsa pero kailangang paalalahanang kumpirmahin ang resources o magdagdag ng panukat.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Names an owner and date but needs a prompt to confirm resources or add a measure.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Hindi kumpirmadong resources ang ipinapangako o ipinapahiya ang hindi nakatapos.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Promises unconfirmed resources or shames someone who did not finish.
